name: Ignis
source:
Ever since the marriage of King Idris to a woman with no title that he met at the Annual Grand Ball, his hold over his kingdom has steadily slipped from his fingertips. Queen Ella's intelligence and cunning has caused the kingdom to flourish in ways it never has in generations passed. However, this rendered the king as an accessory to the throne, confidence in his authority gone, and that's not even the worst part.

Four years after their marriage, while the two are seen to be getting ready for the Annual Grand Ball that will happen on the Friday of November 13th, King Idris gets a prediction a week prior that a tragedy will occur on the same day.

[From [url=https://skai2blue4u.itch.io/ignis-vn-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
伊德里斯国王在一年一度的盛大舞会上，结识了一位没有贵族头衔的女子，并与她成婚。自那以后，对王国的掌控便逐渐从他手中流失。艾拉王后凭借智慧与谋略，让王国迎来了几代人都未曾见过的繁荣。然而，国王也因此沦为王座旁的陪衬，众人不再信服他的权威。可这还不是最糟糕的。

婚后第四年，两人正为将于11月13日星期五举行的年度盛大舞会做准备。就在舞会前一周，伊德里斯国王得到了一则预言：舞会当天，将有悲剧发生。
